## Section wager

QL connects distinction, re-entry, polarity, ratio, topology, harmonic resolution, and formal incompleteness into one derivational braid. The arche-topos names the coordinated differential field on which these transformations can be written without collapsing their mathematical differences.

**Present burden:** show every load-bearing derivation in complete local form, identify the invariant or operation carried between domains, and reserve claim-status labels for the audit boundary rather than weakening the proof movement.
